name: Inky (Pimoroni)
description: A Pimoroni Inky panel (Impression or pHAT/wHAT) on the Raspberry Pi's SPI and I2C. The board says which model it is, so there is nothing to choose.

properties.name: saturation
properties.title: Inky Palette Saturation
properties.description: How saturated the colors of a 7-color Inky Impression are drawn: its palette is blended with this much of the pure colors. 0.5 suits most panels. Other Inky boards ignore it.

properties.name: borderColor
properties.title: Border Color
properties.description: The color of the panel's border: the thin frame around the picture that the picture does not cover. What a board can show depends on its model: white and black on every one, red or yellow on the ones that have that ink, and green, blue and orange on the 7-color Impressions. A color the board does not have is left at white (the log says so).
